@graph.name: Salary Benchmarking Tool
@graph.description: Employer-facing tool to explore illustrative salary ranges by role, level, industry, and location for high-growth hiring markets.

mainEntity.name: What data does the tool use?

acceptedAnswer.text: It aggregates salary survey data from reputable sources, labor statistics, and employer submissions. All figures represent actual paid salaries, not just advertised ranges.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this for entry-level roles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. The tool includes entry-level positions and can break out graduate or junior roles separately. This helps budget for new hires fresh out of school.

mainEntity.name: How often is the data updated?

acceptedAnswer.text: We update the database quarterly to reflect market changes (inflation, new regulations, etc.) so you always see current pay ranges.
